newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Spine-Tech estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Spine-Tech estimates up.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist raised its earnings and revenue estimates for Spine-Tech Inc following the company's report of first quarter profits of $0.10 a share versus a loss of $0.03 a year ago.

-- Hambrecht raised its 1997 estimates to net earnings of $0.52 a share on revenues of $45 million, from $0.35 and $41 million. It raised its 1998 estimates to net income of $0.85 a share on revenues of $74 million, from $0.70 and $59 million.
-- In a statement, Hambrecht said the company's products have outperformed expectations early in their ramp-up, and the company is expanding its sales force to 60 people from 33.
